mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bid_stat_hourly (stat_hour, slot_code, category_code, cnt, ad_cnt, avg_cost_ms, p99_cost_ms, avg_pay_price, total_cost) VALUES (#{statHour}, #{slotCode}, #{categoryCode}, #{cnt}, #{adCnt}, #{avgCostMs}, #{p99CostMs}, #{avgPayPrice}, #{totalCost}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE cnt = cnt + #{cnt}, ad_cnt = ad_cnt + #{adCnt}, avg_cost_ms= GREATEST(avg_cost_ms, #{avgCostMs}), p99_cost_ms= GREATEST(p99_cost_ms, #{p99CostMs}), total_cost = total_cost + #{totalCost}
